rows.author: F061
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A UNIFIED HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT FUND AND A CENTRALIZED HOME FINANCING PROGRAM, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7835, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"COMPREHENSIVE AND INTEGRATED SHELTER FINANCING ACT (CISFA) OF 1994\"
rows.abstract:
Seeks to amend key provisions of RA 7835 or the Comprehensive and Integrated Shelter Finance Act (CISFA) of 1994 to establish, among others, a Unified Housing and Urban Development Fund to make long-term and affordable financing for housing purposes accessible for qualified low-income earners in need of a home of their own even they are not members of the SSS, GSIS of the Pag-IBIG Fund.

Further aims to establish a Centralized Home Financing Program that shall be sourced out by tapping key fund sources already been identified by law: among them, RA 7835 or CISFA, RA8282 or the amended SSS charter, RA8291 of the amended GSIS Charter and RA9679 of the new Pag-IBIG Fund Charter.
rows.status: Deliberated upon by the Mother Committee on 2019-11-13

rows.author: J030
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE PHILIPPINE ECONOMIC ZONE AUTHORITY (PEZA) TO ACCELERATE COUNTRYSIDE DEVELOPMENT THROUGH ROBUST CREATION OF SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONES IN RURAL AND NEW GROWTH AREAS, ENHANCING THE INCENTIVES THEREOF, AND AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7916, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT  NO. 8748, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE ACT OF 1995\"
rows.abstract:
Intends to maximize the investments in the economic zones and obtain more significant gains for
the Filipinos and the country at large, especially the less developed areas in the countryside.

Seeks to strengthen PEZA by: granting additional powers and function; establishment of a globally 
competitive and conducive investment climate and facility; competitive and appropriate incentives package in order to attract more investors to the countryside; creation of opportunities for more investment portfolios; increased financial capability of the designated authority; reduced import dependence by empowering, capacitating and incentivizing domestic enterprises, farmers, fishermen and every Filipino; and more empowered and capable LGUs that are self-reliant, self-sustaining and resource-generating .
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECONOMIC AFFAIRS since 2019-08-20
